info.name: MODORMC
info.description: Admin App and Sales executive app are app-specific. Shared endpoints exist only in root folders. Set base_url to the server origin (no /api/mobile suffix), plant_id, credentials, and target_app=admin or sales. Login tokens are captured automatically. Root requests select the matching prefix/token. Admin PO/order APIs require no module permissions. Lead/quotation reviews retain their own checks. Run delete and negative cases individually. See docs/postman/MODORMC-README.md.

item.name: Connection settings
item.description: Requires sales-mobile bearer token and X-Plant-Id. History is scoped to the user and plant. Use notification UUID, never numeric push_log_id. Live delivery uses Reverb while connected; FCM/APNs is not implemented. On tap map subject_type + subject_id to the app screen and load the record through its API; record permissions still apply. CrmLead -> GET /leads/{id}; Quotation -> GET /quotations/{id}; SalesOrder -> GET /orders/{id}; CustomerPO -> GET /customer-pos (no detail endpoint). There is no public send-test endpoint: create/update a disposable business record with the normal API, with PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED, Reverb and queue worker running. Filter live events by plant_id and refresh history on reconnect. Requires PUSH_NOTIFICATION.RECEIVE to subscribe. Only connect when enabled, configured and can_receive are true. Saves notification_channel; obtain socket_id from a real WebSocket connection before authorizing.

item.name: Current attendance
item.description: Self-service attendance for the employee linked to the token user in X-Plant-Id; no client personnel_id, timestamps, hours, status or shift overrides are allowed. Call check-in after login/plant selection and check-out before auth/logout. Login/logout alone do not punch attendance. Server time and entity timezone are authoritative. Repeated punches preserve timestamps; one session per employee/work date. Stale sessions over 24 hours, manual/HR records and payroll conflicts require HR correction. Attendance does not directly send business push notifications. Notification behavior: this request does not directly trigger a business push notification.

exec: const a=pm.response.json().data.attendance; if(a) pm.environment.set('attendance_id',a.id); else pm.environment.unset('attendance_id');
